The average rate of change of a function or a set of measurements over an interval is defined as the total change in the value divided by the total change in time: `(value_final - value_initial) / (time_final - time_initial)`. 

Confidence level: 99%

```python
def avg_rate(series):
    time_start, value_start = series[0]
    time_end, value_end = series[-1]
    
    rate = (value_end - value_start) / (time_end - time_start)
    
    return f"{rate:.2f}"
```
